method: Three subagents independently reviewed Python drivers/oracles, runtime references, and C tests/probes; primary agent ran clean full builds and regression suites.
Searched declarations, direct callers, dynamic ctypes/getattr names, CMake registration and documented/manual probe uses before removing code.
108 existing C test source files are referenced by CMake; assert-based tests explicitly retain assertions with NDEBUG. Standalone oracles and deliberately failing legacy GPU controls are retained.
scope.boundaries: Original assets, EXEs, keys, patches and existing user saves were not modified. Generated fixtures and build output remain in ignored build/ or temporary directories.

removed.coverage: Removed only its dedicated wall-presentation assertions; retained fixed-step timing, native two-frame timing across 15/20/30/60/120/240 Hz, invalid/backwards time and input-edge checks.

removed.proof: Only tests/test_pcm.c and tests/test_pcm_mix.py called these elapsed-time adapters; runtime/media/audio.c already uses bk_pcm_phase_advance and bk_pcm_mix_phase. Removed duplicate position arithmetic.
removed.coverage: Migrated tests to the production phase API, retaining independent Python integer phase/sample expectations, chunk consistency, UINT64 clocks, loop/end boundaries, gain/pan, invalid-input atomicity and 4000 piecewise-frequency cases.

retained: All Python original-instruction oracles, including manual/dynamically selected suites.

fixed.evidence: Nine portable registered test executables plus ARM64 math were missing from test-host.sh's initial hand-maintained ASan build list.
fixed.change: Build all default CPU targets before CTest; remove redundant later partial build. Set UBSan halt_on_error=1 and disable LeakSanitizer consistently.

fixed.issue: macOS settings test did not compile
fixed.evidence: Fresh RelWithDebInfo build failed: mkdtemp undeclared with _POSIX_C_SOURCE alone.
fixed.change: Add _DARWIN_C_SOURCE for test-settings on Apple, following test-store's existing convention; retain settings tests.

fixed.issue: Stale scene service initializers broke GPU/probe builds
fixed.evidence: -Werror=missing-field-initializers for new show_dev_overlay; both direct and nested initializers affected.
fixed.change: Convert 33 tools initializers to designated fields, preserving original service values and zero defaults.

fixed.issue: macOS offscreen application could not link
fixed.evidence: application.c guarded five native window/menu call blocks with __APPLE__, but host.c intentionally implements an offscreen backend.
fixed.change: Define BK_NATIVE_DARWIN for bk_app only when APPLE AND BK_NATIVE_WINDOW; retain native menu/focus/resize/cap behavior without introducing host stubs.

fixed.issue: Empty audits overwrote evidence with successful zero-work reports
fixed.evidence: audit_game.py, audit_models.py and audit_pcm.py accepted missing/empty input or no target payload.
fixed.change: Reject inputs with no PP archives before loading libraries; reject zero archive entries/models/WAVs before writing reports. Regression checks preserve existing report contents.

fixed.issue: PCM probe accepted zero files and ignored uppercase WAV
fixed.evidence: A synthetic legal empty PP returned PASS PCM 0 files; '.WAV' was ignored by strcmp.
fixed.change: Reject zero decoded WAVs and match extension case-insensitively; synthetic empty and TONE.WAV fixtures test real native execution.

fixed.issue: Linux validation drivers hashed nonexistent macOS library names
fixed.evidence: Five current check drivers hardcoded libmodel-test.dylib.
fixed.change: Follow existing platform-dependent library naming. Isolated harness reproduces all five original Linux failures and checks ten corrected macOS/Linux paths; this is not native Linux execution.

fixed.evidence: A valid synthetic PP reached hashlib.file_digest, unavailable in system Python 3.9.6.
fixed.change: Use streaming hashlib.sha256 while preserving bounded-memory hashing. Positive audit test checks the resulting digest and native archive index.

fixed.issue: Meaningful GPU probes were outside CTest
fixed.evidence: The initial 12-test GPU CTest run passed while test-host.sh's extra depth-clear probe failed on the same GPU.
fixed.change: Register texture-update, GPU transfer, depth-clear and actor-view probes with CTest, and remove duplicate direct invocations from test-host.sh.

fixed.issue: Depth-clear probe caught a real rendering regression
fixed.evidence: The unchanged pixel assertion failed at frame 2, x=4, y=3 with depth=0.5: a green stamp rendered transparent black on Apple M1 Pro / MoltenVK 1.4.2. Rebinding only the pipeline did not repair it; rebinding descriptors did. Removing the fix reproduced failure again.
fixed.change: After vkCmdClearAttachments, call the existing reset_graphics_bindings helper so subsequent draws rebind graphics resources. Preserve pixel thresholds and improve the probe's failing-expression diagnostics. No claim that the Vulkan state contract itself changed.
fixed.regression: 120 frames, 921600 exact RGBA-channel checks, 120 capture/resume operations and stable-allocation assertions.
